title: Archer pawn: what follows the camera pitch, and corrected arrow steering
intro: About 90 s, three parts, each started with End. Arisen must be an Archer; an Archer pawn in the party; stand facing a wall or cliff for part 3.

steps.each_frame:
if not _G.AIMP_loaded then _G.AIMP_loaded = true end

_G.AIMP = { res = {} }
local A = _G.AIMP
A.snap = function(who)
  local S, seen = {}, {}
  local function add(o, name, depth)
    if type(o) ~= "userdata" then return end
    local okt, t = pcall(o.get_type_definition, o); if not (okt and t) then return end
    local oka, addr = pcall(o.get_address, o)
    if oka and addr and addr ~= 0 then if seen[addr] then return end; seen[addr] = true end
    local d = 0
    while t and d < 6 do
      local tn = t:get_full_name()
      if tn == "System.Object" or tn == "System.ValueType" or tn == "via.Component" or tn == "via.Behavior" then break end
      for _, f in ipairs(t:get_fields()) do
        local oks, st = pcall(f.is_static, f)
        if not (oks and st) then
          local fn = f:get_name()
          local ok, v = pcall(o.get_field, o, fn)
          if ok then
            local tv = type(v)
            if tv == "number" then S[name .. "." .. fn] = v
            elseif tv == "boolean" then S[name .. "." .. fn] = v and 1 or 0
            elseif tv == "userdata" then
              local okn, ftn = pcall(function() return v:get_type_definition():get_full_name() end)
              if not okn then
                pcall(function() S[name .. "." .. fn .. ".x"] = v.x + 0.0; S[name .. "." .. fn .. ".y"] = v.y + 0.0; S[name .. "." .. fn .. ".z"] = v.z + 0.0 end)
                pcall(function() S[name .. "." .. fn .. ".w"] = v.w + 0.0 end)
              elseif depth > 0 and (ftn:find("Job02") or ftn:find("Aim") or ftn:find("Shoot") or ftn:find("Shot") or ftn:find("Bow") or ftn:find("Detail") or ftn:find("InputProcessor") or ftn:find("Param") or ftn:find("Nullable") or ftn:find("LookAt") or ftn:find("Angle")) then
                add(v, name .. "." .. fn, depth - 1)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      t = t:get_parent_type(); d = d + 1
    end
  end
  pcall(function()
    local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0)
    local ch, pip
    if who == "arisen" then
      ch = H.arisen()
      local pl = ch:get_GameObject():call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.Player"))
      pip = pl and pl:get_field("InputProcessor")
    else
      ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter")
      pip = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.native and _G.DPC_dbg.native.pip
    end
    add(ch, "C", 1); add(ch:call("get_Human"), "H", 1); add(pip, "P", 2); add(mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController"), "Cam", 1)
    pcall(function() add(ch:get_GameObject():call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.CharacterLookAt")), "Look", 1) end)
  end)
  local n = 0; for _ in pairs(S) do n = n + 1 end
  S.__n = n
  return S
end
A.pitch = function()
  local z = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform"):call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
  return math.deg(math.asin(math.max(-1, math.min(1, -z.y))))
end
A.track = function(who)
  local T = A[who] or {}; A[who] = T
  local okp, pitch = pcall(A.pitch); if not okp then return end
  local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return end
  local cur = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController")
  if not (cur and cur:get_type_definition():get_name():find("Aim", 1, true)) then return end
  if not T.U1 then if pitch > 8 then T.U1 = A.snap(who); T.pU1 = pitch end
  elseif not T.D1 then if pitch < -8 then T.D1 = A.snap(who); T.pD1 = pitch end
  elseif not T.U2 then
    if pitch > 8 then
      T.U2 = A.snap(who); T.pU2 = pitch
      local out, n = {}, 0
      for k, u1 in pairs(T.U1) do
        local d1, u2 = T.D1[k], T.U2[k]
        if d1 and u2 and k ~= "__n" then
          local span = math.abs(u1 - d1)
          if span > 0.02 and math.abs(u1 - u2) <= 0.3 * span then out[k] = string.format("up %.3f | down %.3f | up %.3f", u1, d1, u2); n = n + 1 end
        end
      end
      A.res[who] = { fields = out, n = n, total = T.U1.__n, pitch = string.format("%.1f / %.1f / %.1f", T.pU1, T.pD1, T.pU2) }
      T.stage = "done: " .. n .. " of " .. tostring(T.U1.__n) .. " values follow the pitch"
      pcall(json.dump_file, "DPC_probe_aim_pitch.json", A.res)
    end
  end
  if not T.U2 then T.stage = (not T.U1 and "look UP (waiting)" or (not T.D1 and "now look DOWN" or "now look UP again")) .. string.format("  pitch %.0f", pitch) end
end

steps.text: 1/3 ARISEN. Press End, HOLD AIM, then slowly look UP, then DOWN, then UP again (the screen tells you which). 12 s
ARISEN: HOLD AIM. Follow the 'a_stage' line: look UP, then DOWN, then UP again
2/3 PAWN (steering off). Possess the ARCHER (F6 / F7). Press End, HOLD AIM, then look UP, DOWN, UP again as before. 12 s
PAWN: HOLD AIM. Follow the 'p_stage' line: look UP, then DOWN, then UP again
Release aim. Next: steering ON, fixed version
3/3 PAWN, steering ON (corrected). Press End, HOLD AIM 10 s, aim at a mark on a wall and shoot several arrows. Bow steady? Do arrows hit the reticle, also up and down?
PAWN (steering ON): HOLD AIM, shoot at a mark. Bow steady? Arrows on the reticle?

probes.t_up:

return H.node(mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"), 1)
probes.has:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local v = ch:call("get_AimTargetPosition"); if not v then return nil end
local has = v:get_field("_HasValue")
return has == true
probes.tgt:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local v = ch:call("get_AimTargetPosition"); if not v then return nil end
local has = v:get_field("_HasValue")
if not has then return "none" end
local t = v:get_field("_Value")
local tr = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform")
local p, z = tr:call("get_Position"), tr:call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
local dx, dy, dz = t.x - p.x, t.y - p.y, t.z - p.z
local along = -(dx * z.x + dy * z.y + dz * z.z)
local lx, ly, lz = dx + along * z.x, dy + along * z.y, dz + along * z.z
return string.format("along %.1f off %.2f", along, math.sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly + lz * lz))
probes.dbg: return _G.DPC_dbg ~= nil and _G.DPC_dbg.native ~= nil and _G.DPC_dbg.native.pip ~= nil
probes.errs:
local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json"); if not (ok and d) then return nil end
return d.errors
